{{Quote|Miss, will I, stories he would tell of his travels. Quiet his voice was, dry his humor.|Yoda, on Cei Vookto|<ref name="Jedi: Mace Windu">''[[Jedi: Mace Windu]]''</ref>}}
Following the [[Battle of Lianna]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a '''funeral''' was held for [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cei Vookto]], who had sacrificed himself in the battle. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] presided over the ceremony.
